capabilities: Draw per-level colored guide lines beside headings
Indent content blocks to match their owning heading's depth
Render guides in Reading view, Live Preview, and Source mode
Customize colors, spacing, and thickness via CSS variables
Install and manage a companion styling CSS snippet
disambiguation: Not a heading reorganizer or outliner; it only draws visual guide lines and does not change heading text or structure.
extras: The author's personal theme styling was bundled in 1.x and is now an optional CSS snippet; matching the screenshot look requires installing fonts, one of which is paid. Known limitations: embedded notes are not decorated, and wide tables scroll under the guide lines in the editor.
problem: In long notes, heading nesting is hard to see because a heading three screens below its parent looks identical to a top-level one.
summary: Heading guide plugin that draws colored vertical lines beside Markdown headings so their nesting hierarchy is visible in both reading and editing views.
